findings.summary: Change-log entry has three small drifts, all fixable in one edit. (1) It opens 'Chunk 1 of `.prawduct/artifacts/build-plan.md`', but that file is gitignored and not on origin/main (`git ls-files` is empty; it shows as `!!`), so once merged the pointer resolves for nobody, and will later point at whatever unrelated plan occupies that path. Delete the pointer or make it relational, e.g. 'Chunk 1 of 3 of the #2020 dry-run tooling dispatch'. (2) 'Not in this chunk' says the Medusa hub 'needs a PM/Architect decision'. The plan records that the PM already chose Option B (Medusa ff69a0a1, Chunk 3: stub hub), so the claim is superseded. Say it lands in Chunk 3. (The commit 5c419b47 body says the same, which is fine as history.) (3) The entry does not mention commit 178435b8's change: a refused POST /api/setup/complete now surfaces the server's code and message. Critic O-2 noted the same gap in CHANGELOG.md. Prose only, and no gate reads it. Worth accepting, or fixing in any commit already coming, since change-log.md is under .prawduct/ and should move no coverage (confirm with `prawduct-hook cost-of-commit .prawduct/change-log.md`).

Backlog reconciliation unavailable: this repo sets no `backlog_service_repo:`, so there is no cache scope to resolve the cited ids (2020, 153) against. R-2 was run by hand over the inputs. Both commits say only 'Refs #2020', and the change-log entry claims no `closes:`/`closed-by:`, so no closure is claimed that could disagree with the backlog. #2020 correctly stays open, since Chunks 2 and 3 remain. A sync cannot fix this (it is a config gap, not a stale cache), so no action is needed for this PR.
